offering_description.value: A non-traded real estate investment trust that owns and leases healthcare properties such as senior housing, medical office buildings and skilled nursing facilities. It earns rent from healthcare operators and tenants, and raises capital from investors.

primary_services.value: healthcare property leasing; real estate asset management

customer_segment.value: B2B: healthcare operators and physician tenants leasing properties

end_markets.value: healthcare real estate; senior housing; medical offices; skilled nursing

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: rent from leased healthcare facilities

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns healthcare properties and leases them to operators and tenants

geography_served.value: US national: healthcare properties in multiple US states

specialization.value: related lines: senior housing, medical office, skilled nursing and other healthcare property types

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct lease negotiations with healthcare operators and tenants

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: REIT tax rules and SEC reporting, tenants subject to Medicare/Medicaid and healthcare licensing rules
